vanilla.observedShape: Vanilla includes Lighthouse Rogue-elimination work such as Easy Job - Part 2 / Rogue kill objectives, but the reviewed comparator does not add mandatory successful extraction to the same bounded Rogue contract.

observedObjectives: Eliminate any targets in the Lighthouse region
Survive and extract from the location
scorpion.difference: The target is generic rather than the pinned Rogue/exUsec target and the event/party-distraction purpose is not a Rogue perimeter-interdiction contract.

artem.observedQuest: Bag n' Tag / Grab n' Tag
artem.observedShape: Water-treatment ex-USEC/Rogue elimination; pinned quest data uses savageRole exUsec and the player-facing objective asks for three Rogues, alongside a separate supply handover.

decision.review: Rogue Interdiction occupies a crowded semantic area. Vanilla and Artem already cover Lighthouse/Rogue elimination, while Scorpion combines Lighthouse combat and extraction. The Admiral operation remains admissible only as a narrowly bounded target-specific Rogue perimeter disruption: at most six exUsec targets, no escalating hunt ladder, no generic-target fallback, no Rogue gear faucet, and mandatory successful extraction. This review therefore closes external overlap but makes the Rogue-specific target and bounded anti-grind shape permanent differentiation requirements.

regressionBoundary: If Rogue Interdiction loses exUsec target specificity, gains generic-target fallback, exceeds six targets, becomes repeatable/escalating, or drops mandatory extraction, it collides materially with the reviewed external content and must fail closed.
